posts.title: A deep cleaning checklist for Greer homes
posts.text:
If your last professional clean was months ago, deep cleaning in Greer, SC is the reset that regular tidying cannot give you. Here is the checklist our team works from, room by room.

Kitchen: degrease cabinet fronts and handles, wipe the range hood and backsplash, and clean appliance exteriors.
Bathrooms: scrub grout lines, wipe behind and around the toilet base, and polish glass and fixtures.
Throughout the house: hand-wipe baseboards and door frames, dust ceiling fan blades, vents and light fixtures, and clean window sills, tracks and blinds.

These are the spots a quick weekly clean skips, and they are where dust and build-up hide in homes from the older streets near Downtown Greer to newer neighborhoods off SC-101. Deep cleaning also works well before the holidays or before you start recurring maid service, and it helps allergy sufferers because dust is removed, not moved around.

posts.text:
Planning a move and need move out cleaning in Lyman, SC? Here is how the free estimate works, so there are no surprises before your final walkthrough.

You book a time, and a member of the Perfect Services team visits the home in person. They walk through the kitchen, bathrooms, closets and floors, see the real condition of the space, and then give you an exact price. There is no commitment, and you decide afterward whether to book.

The visit matters because a mill home on US-29 and a newer build off SC-292 can need very different amounts of work. Once you book, the clean covers the inside of every cabinet and drawer, the refrigerator, freezer, oven and microwave, bathroom grout and vanity interiors, closet shelves and floors, plus baseboards, door frames and light switches.

posts.title: Post-construction cleaning before the holidays
posts.text:
Finishing a remodel before the holidays? Post construction cleaning in Wade Hampton, SC is often the last job between the contractor leaving and the family moving back into the kitchen.

Fall is a busy stretch for renovations in Greenville County, and many homeowners along US-29 and near I-385 want a finished kitchen or bathroom before guests arrive. The problem is the fine dust. It settles on ledges, trim, light fixtures and inside cabinets, and it keeps coming back if it is only wiped once.

Our team removes dust from every surface and vent, cleans inside cabinets and closets, washes windows, tracks and sills, takes off paint specks and sticker residue, polishes new fixtures, and washes floors in multiple passes. A final touch-up pass follows, so the space is ready to use.

It works for homeowners, builders and contractors alike. Plan the cleaning for the day after the last trade finishes. Tap Learn more to see what is included in Wade Hampton.
